title: Support inbox
subtitle: Human messages captured from the bot channels. Instance-wide, super-admin only.

sections.activeHelp: Open and pending threads we can still reply to.
sections.expiredHelp: Still unanswered, and we cannot reply — the free-form window has lapsed, or there is no route back to the sender.
sections.closedHelp: Dealt with. Purged after the retention period.

thread.attributionHelp: A hint about who wrote in. It does not give that organization access to this thread.
thread.truncated: This message was truncated when it was stored.

reply.disabledNoRoute: This thread cannot be replied to from here.
reply.costWarning: This channel bills per message segment. Replies pass the same spend guards as alerting.
